clips.text: Meditation requires understanding and not effort, understanding is essential, not effort, and remember always that you cannot substitute understanding with any effort whatsoever.
But what do I mean by understanding?
By understanding I mean - living a natural life.
Of course, you cannot try to be natural, that is self-contradictory!
You can be natural but you cannot try to be natural.
Suzuki tells a story: A monk once asked one of the old Chinese masters: What is the way?
The master replied: The natural one, the ordinary one, is the way How, continued the monk, am I to be in accord with it?
When you try to be in accord with it, said the master, then you deviate from it.
